speaker: Miku
text: Hey Teto, your voice is like a sunrise.

speaker: Teto
text: Oh? And yours must be the glittering night sky.

speaker: Miku
text: Only if you promise to sing along with me.

speaker: Teto
text: I could, but only if you let me steal a kiss.

speaker: Miku
text: Deal—just make sure you don't bite.

speaker: Teto
text: No promises, but I'll try to be gentle.
